name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes: v1.8.5 — UX polish, two changes bundled. (1) New 'Save sprint parameters' button in the 'Sprint intro' card on the Planning tab — explicit save entry point for the shared fields (sprint name, dates, optional Sprint/Version); the per-role 'Save parameters' button inside role accordions is unchanged and continues to save shared fields plus the role's resource. One new i18n key in 15 locales. (2) Click-anchored toast positioning — the YouTrack widget runs in a sandboxed iframe where `position:fixed` pins to the iframe frame rather than the parent viewport and `window.parent.document` is cross-origin blocked, which caused toasts to disappear off-screen or render as a vertical block. Toasts now capture the last user click coordinates and render ~280px above the click on the opposite X-side, guaranteeing visibility without overlapping the just-clicked button. Single-line `nowrap+ellipsis` rendering replaces the previous multi-line block. No schema impact, no breaking changes, 209 unit tests pass. See CHANGELOG.md.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
